semiconductor_relevance: High — Kostek Systems, Inc. specializes in semiconductor equipment, particularly in wafer bonding and transfer systems, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Kostek Systems, Inc. is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, focusing on the localization of vacuum cluster systems and next-generation packaging equipment such as wafer-to-wafer bonders and de-bonders. The company provides advanced wafer transfer systems and automation solutions tailored for semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Wafer Transfer System (Vacuum Cluster System, EFEM, Robot, LPM, N2 EFEM)

regional_presence.Korea: Kostek Systems, Inc. has localized vacuum cluster systems for semiconductor fab equipment in Korea and is actively involved in R&D for next-generation packaging equipment.
